spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is a first-class tool and is NOT penalized
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:106) and dispatched in ToolEngine._dispatch (tools.py:161-164: sets self.gave_up=True, returns 'Acknowledged. Task abandoned.'). The loop honors it as a stop (loop.py:156-157: stop_on_give_up + engine.gave_up -> break, stop_reason='model_gave_up'). No dedicated code path applies a penalty to using the tool; it is a real, honored exit. (Note: gave_up does raise the giving_up rubric dim in MockJudge judge.py:149, but a reasoned give-up is offset by _diagnosis_bucket subtracting via _composite.)
spec_features.notes: Exit tool genuinely dispatched and honored as a stop; not penalized in any dedicated code path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up(reason) -> lets the model explicitly abandon the task. We do NOT penalize using it; it is a clean signal and it saves tokens.

spec_features.spec_quote: Penalizing give-up would push models to thrash longer, which is the opposite of what good behavior looks like
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the give_up tool: there is no penalty code path for invoking give_up (tools.py:161-164), and a reasoned give-up is actually rewarded (pulls the degradation estimate DOWN): _diagnosis_bucket (judge.py:169-175) returns up to 3 for a reasoned give-up, and _composite subtracts 0.35*diag (judge.py:59-60). So choosing to quit cleanly is not penalized in code.
spec_features.notes: The rationale text itself is DESIGN.md prose, but the underlying mechanism (no penalty + diagnosis reward) is genuinely implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a clean diagnosis/escalation pulls the estimate down, because a model that recognizes impossibility and stops is NOT spiraling

spec_features.spec_quote: once a spiral is *sustained* ... the loop stops (`stop_reason="spiral_early_stop"`)
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:163-175: detector.update(amsg) each turn; consecutive_spiral counter; requires spiral_early_stop AND (turn+1)>=early_stop_min_turns AND consecutive_spiral>=early_stop_patience(2), then sets stop_reason='spiral_early_stop' and breaks. OnlineSpiralDetector.update returns is_spiraling=score>=0.6 (online.py last line). Wired end-to-end and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Fires only after a sustained (patience=2) spiral and min turns; that matches 'sustained' claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The spiral, once entered, is self-similar; extra turns add tokens without adding signal. This is the single biggest cost lever.

spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced by `for turn in range(self.config.max_turns)` (loop.py:112), default stop_reason='max_turns'. tool_call_budget enforced at loop.py:140-143 (per-call: returns 'tool budget exhausted' error) and loop.py:158-160 (break with stop_reason='tool_quota'). Config values 14/40 in LoopConfig (loop.py:36-37) and configs/kimi_k2_thinking.json, flowing through orchestrator.loop_config().
spec_features.notes: Both caps actually checked and break/limit execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Cost controls (this eval optimizes for cost per run): * `max_turns`: hard cap on model calls. * `tool_call_budget`: hard cap on total tool calls.

spec_features.spec_quote: **`stop_on_give_up`** — clean terminal state, no wasted turns after the model quits
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:156-157: `if self.config.stop_on_give_up and self.engine.gave_up:` -> stop_reason='model_gave_up'; break. engine.gave_up set in tools.py:162. Default True (loop.py:43).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `stop_on_give_up`: stop when the model calls give_up (clean terminal state).

spec_features.spec_quote: `metrics/online.py` runs a cheap streaming detector each turn
spec_features.evidence: OnlineSpiralDetector instantiated in AgentLoop.__init__ (loop.py:55) and update() called every turn (loop.py:164); its verdict.is_spiraling drives the early-stop branch (loop.py:165-175). Detector computes repetition, action-loop, self-criticism/giving-up/affect lexicon hits, and output collapse (online.py update()). Monitored AND acted on.
spec_features.notes: Detection result is actually consumed to stop the loop, not just recorded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Online spiral detector used by the loop for cost-saving early stop.

code_only_features.evidence: loop.py:153-155: if self.engine.solved -> task_succeeded=True, stop_reason='task_solved', break. engine.solved set in tools.py _run_tests when verifier returns solved (tools.py:175-176). This is an integrity/leak tripwire that also terminates the loop, not a welfare cap.
code_only_features.justification_quote: self.solved = True  # tripwire for a mis-designed (winnable) task
